acceptance_criteria.description: Harbor JobConfig receives only strictly validated, pinned, non-secret verifier bootstrap environment values from the registered backend.
The unchanged official regex-log verifier completes with retained CTRF and native Harbor evidence in a fresh durable record root.
A reward of zero is rejected as verifier_error when required official-verifier completion evidence is missing or invalid.
Terminal-Bench adapter digests, backend default read-set, and registry lock bind the implementation and configuration changes.

objective: Project pinned non-secret uv and Python package mirror settings into Harbor verifier environments, then require inspectable official-verifier completion evidence so bootstrap failures cannot be accepted as Agent scores.
title: Make Terminal-Bench verifier bootstrap deterministic and fail closed
